title: Software Engineer Intern Spring/Summer 2027
description:
Radiance Technologies is an employee-owned company with benefits that are unmatched by most companies in the Huntsville, AL or Dayton, OH areas. Employee ownership, generous 401K, full health/dental/life/vision insurance benefits, interesting assignments, educational reimbursement, competitive salaries, and a pleasant work environment combine to make Radiance Technologies a great place to work and succeed.

The Software Engineer Intern will be involved in full stack software development, debugging, and testing. Development will be in a variety of both front-end and back-end languages, including Javascript, Python, Go, C#, and/or C++. Software being developed will be used in support of the National Air and Space Intelligence Center (NASIC).

This internship is onsite at our Beavercreek, OH office. Remote work is not available.

Hourly rate: $21.00 - $26.00 (Pay will vary depending on the Interns year in school and experience).

Requirements

Sophomore, Junior or Senior currently pursuing bachelor’s degree in computer science or relevant technical field
Minimum 3.0 GPA (GPA must be on resume to be considered)
Classroom level experience programming in any of the following languages (C#, C++, Java, Python)
US Citizenship with the ability to obtain a security clearance
Good communication and problem-solving skills

Desired Qualifications

Experience with Javascript and popular Javascript Frameworks (React, Angular)
Experience with Linux
Experience with Elasticsearch, MongoDB
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and basic CI/CD principles

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
